title: fix(cloud-connection,cli): the install-local ledger follows OS_HOME, so os dev --fresh starts without earlier installs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8wW3DTJphDWvE6eMmCmuPe)_

domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY4LWqfjLCYqpZhNCs

Fixes #30217

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 本地安装账本（install-local 缓存目录）不再固定在工作目录：设了 `OS_HOME` 就放 `$OS_HOME/installed-packages`，没设仍在 `CWD/.objectstack/installed-packages`。旧位置的已有安装在新目录第一次出现时复制一次过去（旧文件不删），`os dev --fresh` 不复制；`os doctor` 读运行时同一个目录。
- **为什么改：** `os dev --fresh` 或换一个 `OS_HOME` 的第二个实例，库是新的，却把上一次装过的包又加载回来，测试互相污染。
- **风险与回滚：** 不设 `OS_HOME` 的 `os dev`、项目模式的 `os start`（`OS_HOME=CWD/.objectstack`）路径不变；设了别的 `OS_HOME` 的部署首次启动会复制旧账本并打一行警告。复制失败打 error，下次启动重试，旧文件始终不动。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/cloud-connection/src/local-manifest-source.ts`（`resolveInstalledPackagesDir`、`adoptLegacyEntries`），`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 `adoptLegacyLedger`，`packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts` 的 `readInstalledPackageEntries`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-storage-dir.test.ts`，预期 10 个测试全过（含 `--fresh` 不复制、设 `OS_HOME` 复制一次、卸载后不复活）。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`@objectstack/cloud-connection`**

- `resolveInstalledPackagesDir({ env?, cwd? })` is the one answer to where the ledger lives: `$OS_HOME/installed-packages` when `OS_HOME` is set (a leading `~` expanded the way the home resolver does), `CWD/.objectstack/installed-packages` when it is not. It also returns `legacyDir`: the working-directory ledger, whenever the answer moved away from it, else `null`.
- Unset stays in the project on purpose. `os dev` without `OS_HOME` keeps its database in the project, and the ledger has to sit beside the database whose sample-data rows its entries describe; `~/.objectstack` would make one ledger serve every project on the machine. `os start` in project mode sets `OS_HOME` to `CWD/.objectstack`, so its ledger is the same directory as before.
- `LocalManifestSource()` with no `storageDir` uses that answer and keeps `legacyDir`; an explicit `storageDir` adopts nothing.
- `LocalManifestSource.adoptLegacyEntries()` copies the legacy directory's `.json` files byte for byte into the ledger directory, once: only while the ledger directory does not exist yet. The copy goes to a sibling staging directory that is renamed into place, so a failure leaves no half-made ledger and the next boot copies again. The legacy files are left in place, so an `OS_HOME` pointed at a throwaway directory never takes a project's installs with it, and they are not read again, so an uninstall in the new place sticks. `list()` and `read()` never adopt: a reader such as `os doctor` must not write.
- `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin.rehydrate` calls it before the ledger read. A copy is a `warn` naming both directories and asking for the old one to be removed; a failed copy is an `error` (the old ledger lists packages this runtime does not load, and the boot looks normal otherwise), naming both directories and the fix.
- Under `os dev --fresh` nothing is adopted: the dev parent names its ephemeral home on the internal channel `OS_INTERNAL_FRESH_HOME`, and the resolver skips the adoption only when that value is the current `OS_HOME`, so an inherited copy speaks for no other run. The channel is between `os dev` and its serve child only; it is not an operator setting and is not documented as one.
- Only the constructor/`storageDir` doc and the adoption before `rehydrate`'s read change in `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`; `runInlineSeed` and the install/uninstall doors are untouched.

**`@objectstack/cli`**

- `os dev` sets `OS_INTERNAL_FRESH_HOME` on its serve child under `--fresh` and removes an inherited copy otherwise (`applyFreshHomeChannel`).
- `os doctor` takes the ledger directory from `resolveInstalledPackagesDir` (under its `.env*` overlay, as `os serve` loads that cascade before the ledger resolves `OS_HOME`), instead of joining `cwd` with `DEFAULT_INSTALLED_PACKAGES_DIR`. Without this, with `OS_HOME` set, doctor and the runtime would read two directories and neither would say so. `OS_HOME` joins `DOCTOR_ENV_INPUTS`, so its provenance is reported. A `@objectstack/cloud-connection` without the resolver is the existing "does not declare the ledger directory" row, now naming `resolveInstalledPackagesDir`.
- `serve.ts` is unchanged: its two `new MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin(...)` sites pass no `storageDir`, and the default now resolves the right directory.

**The widening.** New exports `resolveInstalledPackagesDir`, `INSTALLED_PACKAGES_HOME_SUBDIR`, `FRESH_HOME_CHANNEL_ENV` and the types `InstalledPackagesLocation` / `LegacyLedgerAdoption`; new members `LocalManifestSource.legacyDir` and `adoptLegacyEntries()`. Nothing is removed or narrowed; nothing an author writes changes.

## Tests

- `local-manifest-source.test.ts`: two new describes. The resolver's table (unset and blank, set, `~`, project-mode `os start`, the fresh channel for its own home and for another), the default constructor; `adoptLegacyEntries` copies `.json` byte for byte (an unreadable entry too, reported by `list()` from its new place), leaves the legacy files, leaves no staging directory, adopts nothing once the directory exists, answers `null` without touching the disk, and on a failed copy throws and leaves no ledger directory.
- `marketplace-install-local-storage-dir.test.ts`: a new describe booting the plugin with no `storageDir` — installs land under `$OS_HOME/installed-packages`; a second instance under another `OS_HOME` does not rehydrate the first one's install; the cwd ledger is adopted once and rehydrated, the old file kept, and an uninstall in the new place is not undone on the next boot; a fresh home adopts nothing; a fresh channel naming another home does not stop the adoption; with `OS_HOME` unset the cwd ledger is read with no adoption; a failed copy logs the error naming both directories. The existing cwd-default case now pins `OS_HOME` unset.
- `doctor-ledger-read-failure.test.ts`: with `OS_HOME` set doctor reports the entry under `$OS_HOME/installed-packages` and nothing from a stale cwd ledger; the `#6643` case computes its expectation from the resolver.
- `doctor-ledger-dir-authority.test.ts`: the authority is the resolver function (`not a function`).
- `dev-fresh-home-channel.test.ts` (new): the CLI's spelling equals the package's; set under `--fresh`, removed otherwise.

## Acceptance notes

- **A brand-new non-fresh home adopts the pre-upgrade ledger once.** Two instances started under two new `OS_HOME`s (neither `--fresh`) after this upgrade each copy the working-directory entries that existed before it. Installs made after the upgrade never leak; the old entries stop leaking once the old directory is removed, which the boot warning asks for.
- **Copy, not move.** A move would converge sooner, but any `OS_HOME` pointed at a temporary directory (a test harness, a one-off run) would then take the project's installs into a directory that gets deleted.
- **`os doctor` before the first boot.** With `OS_HOME` set and the new directory not created yet, doctor reads the new (absent) directory and reports nothing installed; the next boot adopts the old entries. Doctor does not write, by design.

## Verification

Real boots of `examples/app-todo` through `os dev --no-watch --log-level info` with one pre-seeded working-directory ledger entry (`com.probe.ledger`, standing for an earlier install), reading the plugin's boot lines and the ledger directories afterwards. Before = `origin/main` sources of the five changed source files restored and both packages rebuilt; after = this branch; ablation = this branch with the fresh-channel return in `resolveInstalledPackagesDir` disabled through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` confirming the marker in 2 built files, then restored (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, `--absent` over 6 built files).

<details><summary>Before / after / ablation, three scenarios</summary>

| Scenario | Before (`main`) | After (this PR) | Ablation (fresh guard off) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OS_HOME` unset | `rehydrated com.probe.ledger@1.0.0`, storage `CWD/.objectstack/installed-packages` | same | same |
| `os dev --fresh` | `rehydrated com.probe.ledger@1.0.0`, storage `CWD/.objectstack/installed-packages` — the defect | no rehydrate, storage `/tmp/objectstack-dev-…/installed-packages`, cwd ledger untouched | `copied 1 installed package(s) … into /tmp/objectstack-dev-…/installed-packages`, `rehydrated com.probe.ledger@1.0.0` — the defect is back |
| `OS_HOME=/tmp/os30217-home-…` | `rehydrated`, storage `CWD/…`, nothing under the home | `copied 1 installed package(s) from CWD/… into HOME_DIR/installed-packages`, `rehydrated`, storage `HOME_DIR/installed-packages`; cwd file kept | same as after |

</details>
